title.en: Renewing and consuming as a relation to participated conditions
title.zh: 参与关系中的更新与消耗：关系性分类

statement.zh: 更新与消耗是形成对其所依存或取用之条件的关系：永久失去更新是每个平衡流的定律，支持门控规律族中超额取用与共同取用使更新终止是其实例，形成自身的轨迹不决定分类。
statement.en: Renewing and consuming are relations of a formation to the conditions it depends on or draws on: loss of renewal for good is a law of every balanced flow, the support-gated family's overdraw and joint drawing end renewal as its instances, and no formation's own trajectory decides its class.

laws.zh: 一项形成若使它依存或取用的每个条件都持续支持依存于该条件的每项形成，则为更新型；若它取用的某个条件使某个依存者永久失去支持，则为消耗型。在任意展开上两类互斥而不穷尽；无更新的取用只容许有限次发生。
laws.en: A formation is renewing when every condition it depends on or draws on keeps supporting each formation that depends on that condition, and consuming when it draws on a condition some dependent formation permanently loses. Over arbitrary unfoldings the classes are exclusive and not exhaustive, and unrenewed drawdown admits finitely many active steps.

laws.zh: 永久失去更新是每个平衡流的定律：给予某条件者都以至少某界的所需依存于它、且活动需要支持时，低于该界的水平此后一直低于它，以这样的所需依存于该条件的每项形成此后都不活跃。
laws.en: Loss of renewal for good is a law of every balanced flow: where whatever gives to a condition depends on it at a need of at least a bound, and activity needs support, a level below the bound stays below it, and every formation depending on the condition at such a need is inactive from then on.

laws.zh: 条件若由依存于它的形成更新，焦点形成的贡献不多于其取用之后，支持门控规律族就是这样的流。
laws.en: When the condition is renewed by a formation that depends on it, the support-gated family is such a flow once the focal formation contributes no more than it draws.

laws.zh: 超出更新的取用使水平低于更新者的所需，此后更新永久终止：依存于该条件的焦点形成随之终止自身、形成量有界，不依存的焦点形成则可以持续并无界形成。
laws.en: Drawing beyond renewal brings the level below the renewer's need, after which the renewal ends for good: a dependent focal formation then ends itself with bounded formation, while an independent one can persist and form without bound.

laws.zh: 每次发生都形成新组织不能决定分类，焦点形成在整个展开中的自身发生与形成轨迹也不能。
laws.en: Forming new organization at every active step does not decide the class, nor does the focal formation's own activity and formation over the whole unfolding.

laws.zh: 各方单独都在更新之内时，共同取用仍可消耗：两个取用者合起来取得多于更新时，更新与它们自身都永久终止；起初在更新之内的升级也可消耗。
laws.en: Joint drawing can consume when each party alone is within renewal: two drawers taking together more than the renewal end the renewal and themselves for good, and escalation that begins within renewal can consume.

hypotheses.en: General part: definitions only. An unfolding supplies condition levels, activity, dependence with support levels, and drawing; Dependent states that a formation is active only where supported.
hypotheses.zh: 一般部分只有定义：展开给出条件水平、发生、带支持水平的依存及取用；Dependent 表示形成只在受支持时发生。

hypotheses.en: Law family: one shared condition with natural-number levels; renewal is added while the condition supports the sustaining formation; the focal formation is active while supported (zero support level means independence) and contributes and draws stated amounts.
hypotheses.zh: 规律族：一个以自然数水平表示的共享条件；条件支持维持性形成时加入更新；焦点形成在受支持时发生（支持水平为零表示不依存），并按给定量贡献与取用。

hypotheses.en: Joint drawing is represented as one law with the summed draw, exact when the drawing formations share the same support level.
hypotheses.zh: 共同取用表示为取用相加的一条规律；当各取用者支持水平相同时这一表示是精确的。

does_not_show.zh: 所完成的是所述表示中的描述性分类及其动力学。
does_not_show.en: The classification and its dynamics are descriptive and complete only within the stated representations.

does_not_show.zh: 未证明真实过程满足规律族。
does_not_show.en: Does not show that real processes satisfy the law family.

does_not_show.zh: 未说明更新循环中的损失如何权衡。
does_not_show.en: Does not say how losses within a renewed cycle are weighed.

does_not_show.zh: Consumed 不要求依存曾被满足：一个从未被满足的依存使条件被消耗、汲取者成为消耗型，而没有任何断裂或丧失（见 becoming-dependence-dynamics）。
does_not_show.en: Consumed does not require the dependence ever to have been met: a requirement never met makes the condition consumed and the drawer consuming without any break or loss (see becoming-dependence-dynamics).

detail.en: own_trajectory_does_not_decide: identical own activity and formation at every step, opposite classes. Persistence, success or growth of a formation is not a criterion of renewal.
detail.zh: own_trajectory_does_not_decide：每一步自身发生与形成完全相同，分类相反。形成的持续、成功或增长都不是更新的判准。

detail.en: fluctuating_neither: support that recurs without lasting is neither renewing nor consuming; the classification is not a forced dichotomy. Cycle-level renewal is later defined in becoming-return-grades, where this condition is renewed within two steps.
detail.zh: fluctuating_neither：反复出现而不持续的支持既非更新型也非消耗型；分类不是强加的二分。周期层面的更新后来在 becoming-return-grades 中定义：这一条件在两步周期内更新。

detail.en: One shared condition in the law family, no substitution between conditions, attribution within joint consumption not formalized, and no ethical ranking in this module (with C and the relational reading, relational-reading-comparison ranks every overdraw of the law family below its absence; mixed cases stay unranked); finite fulfillment, rest and appropriate ending are not consumption.
detail.zh: 规律族只有一个共享条件，条件间替代未建模，共同消耗中的归因未形式化，本模块也没有伦理排序（在 C 与关系读法下，relational-reading-comparison 把规律族中每一种超额取用排在其不发生之下；混合情形仍未排序）；有限完成、休息与适当结束不是消耗。

不由一般定律推出的部分（Becoming.RenewalFlow）：越过支持之点来自规律族自身的算术（overdraw_crosses_support，纯净的基础模块）；依存的焦点形成使水平低于自身所需、其形成量有界，仍是 dependent_overdraw_ends_itself 的规律族算术，此后它的永久终止才是 ends_for_good；independent_overdraw_persists 是规律族中的见证（不依存者可以持续）；jointly_consuming 中每个取用者单独在更新之内为更新型，无法在把两个取用者合为一个焦点形成的规律族中表示，各自份额的一般区分是 Becoming.Continuation 的 WithinOwn、WithinJoint、Pair.own_not_joint 与 joint_excess_ends。
detail.en: What the general laws do not give (Becoming.RenewalFlow): the crossing below support comes from the family's own arithmetic (overdraw_crosses_support, in the pure foundation module); that a dependent focal formation brings the level below its own need, with bounded formation, remains the family arithmetic of dependent_overdraw_ends_itself, and only its ending for good from then on is ends_for_good; independent_overdraw_persists is a witness in the family (an independent formation can persist); and in jointly_consuming each drawer being renewing within renewal alone cannot be represented in the family, which merges the two drawers into one focal formation; the general split of each one's share is Becoming.Continuation's WithinOwn, WithinJoint, Pair.own_not_joint and joint_excess_ends.

next_delta.zh: 在 becoming-return-grades、substitution-preserves-consumption 与 joint-difference-making 已承接的周期层面更新、条件间替代与共同消耗中的差别制造之外：多条件下的替代链及其损失；更精细的归属；为具体案例建立经验对应。
next_delta.en: Beyond the cycle-level renewal, substitution between conditions and difference-making within joint consumption taken up by becoming-return-grades, substitution-preserves-consumption and joint-difference-making: chains of substitution and their losses across several conditions; finer attribution; empirical correspondence for particular cases.

correspondence.zh: 形成、条件与依存是同一展开中分化的方面，不是交换资源的所有者。把规律族读作恶性增长、升级竞赛或以消耗取胜属于解释；实际案例须为其依存、支持水平与速率取得证据。`formed` 计数新组织单位，不是复杂度量。其伦理意义不是 G0 之外另欠的工作：G0 的对象是生生，本分类描述的正是生生（这是 Ren 的更正，此处为 AI 的转述；Ren 问：“为什么？我G0是什么？generative和degenerate虽然都在一个becoming model上，但是他们不overlap吧”，见所引来源）；消耗与其不发生在 C 下的比较，见另一记录 relational-reading-comparison。
correspondence.en: Formations, conditions and dependence are differentiated aspects of one unfolding, not owners exchanging resources. Readings of the law family as malignant growth, escalation or winning by consumption are interpretations; actual cases require evidence for their dependence, support levels and rates. `formed` counts units of new organization and is not a complexity measure. Its ethical significance is not an addition owed beyond G0: G0's object is 生生, which this classification describes (Ren's correction, here in the AI's words; Ren asked “为什么？我G0是什么？generative和degenerate虽然都在一个becoming model上，但是他们不overlap吧”, in the referenced source); the comparison of consumption with its absence under C is the separate record relational-reading-comparison.

detail.en: Narrower law-class result proved independently the same day: under a supplied wear law it bounds total formation by stock plus a triangular renewal bound, shows the local first-step reversal and gives a G0 event-reading interface. Here irreversibility is derived from the renewer's dependence rather than assumed, the classification is general, and externalizing consumption is covered. No import either way.
detail.zh: 同日独立证明的较窄规律类结果：在给定磨损规律下以所持条件加三角更新量界定总形成量，给出第一步局部反转及 G0 逐事件接口。本结果的不可逆由更新者的依存推出而非假定，分类是一般的，并覆盖外部化消耗。互不导入。

detail.en: Interpretive: read with 生生 as its object, G0's positive ground does not attach to consuming formation; this result supplies that object descriptively, without an evaluative filter. Its proof is unchanged.
detail.zh: 解释关联：以生生为对象时，G0 的正面根据不附于消耗型形成；本结果以描述方式给出这一对象，不作价值筛选。其证明不变。

detail.en: Interpretive: a zero-axiom differentiation of generation and degeneration within one relational description; it does not complete the open foundational target.
detail.zh: 解释关联：在同一关系描述中以零公理区分生成与退化；不完成开放的根基目标。

detail.en: Interpretive: no_return_below_support gives one concrete mechanism of non-return; no formal composition with the endpoint theorem is claimed.
detail.zh: 解释关联：no_return_below_support 给出一种具体的不可返回机制；未声称与端点定理的形式组合。

detail.en: Consumer of this classification: imports RelationalRenewal and feeds overdraw_consuming into GenerativeComparison's C under the relational reading of G0's generation. This record's own claims and proofs are unchanged.
detail.zh: 本分类的使用者：导入 RelationalRenewal，在对 G0 之生成的关系读法下把 overdraw_consuming 送入 GenerativeComparison 的 C。本记录自身的主张与证明不变。
该结果给出 fluctuating 的精确等级（两步周期内更新），并证明消耗恰是某个依存不再回程。
detail.en: That result gives fluctuating's exact grade (renewed within two steps) and proves that consumption is exactly a dependence that never returns.

history.zh: 2026-10-14，一般定律（一般定律计划 L2 流，由整合会话分派；AI 撰写，Claude Opus 5.5）：审计发现本记录的超额取用动力学只对支持门控规律族成立。新桥接模块 Becoming.RenewalBridge 表明规律族的每个规律都是其静态网上的平衡流（SupportGated.balances），所以永久失去更新是 Becoming.Continuation 的 Flow.stays_below_at 与 Flow.ends_below_at 的实例（below_for_good、ends_for_good、overdraw_ends），超出更新的共同取用之终止也是，且不需 jointly_consuming 的“各自在更新之内”与起点前提（jointly_ends）。越过支持之点、依存者降到自身所需以下及其形成量有界、independent_overdraw_persists 以及 jointly_consuming 中各取用者单独的一半，仍是规律族的结果，见新增反例条目。主张改写为定律在先；RelationalRenewal 的字节、证明与回执不变。新增对 Becoming.Continuation 与 Becoming.RenewalBridge 的合并回执绑定，合并时须改指首个含有它们的回执。
history.en: 14 October 2026, general law (general-laws plan, stream L2, assigned by the integrating session; AI-authored, Claude Opus 5.5): the audit found that this record's overdraw dynamics held only for the support-gated law family. The new bridge module Becoming.RenewalBridge shows every law of the family to be a balanced flow on its static web (SupportGated.balances), so loss of renewal for good is an instance of Becoming.Continuation's Flow.stays_below_at and Flow.ends_below_at (below_for_good, ends_for_good, overdraw_ends), and the ending of joint drawing beyond renewal is too, without the within-renewal and start premises of jointly_consuming (jointly_ends). The crossing, the dependent formation's descent below its own need with bounded formation, independent_overdraw_persists and the per-drawer half of jointly_consuming stay family results, as the new counterexample entry states. The claim is rewritten law first; RelationalRenewal's bytes, proofs and receipt are unchanged. Bindings to the consolidated receipt for Becoming.Continuation and Becoming.RenewalBridge are added and must be re-pointed to the receipt that first contains them at landing.
